title: Steven J. Davis: evolving research questions, 2008–2026
scope: Representative source-audited research in each publication year from 2008 through September 2026, plus a separately labeled 2026 funded-project announcement. Nineteen year selectors do not mean nineteen separate career pivots or an exhaustive bibliography.
interpretation: Across these overlapping branches, a recurring question is what an accounting boundary or headline target conceals about real consequences and constraints. This is our interpretation of published work, not a quotation or universal description of Davis's research.

chapters.title: How does drainage reorganization affect estimates of ancient elevation?
chapters.question_zh: 河流改道会怎样影响古山高的估算？
chapters.summary: The team used oxygen, carbon and strontium isotopes in ancient lake sediments to show how drainage changes can confound isotope-based elevation interpretations.
chapters.summary_zh: 团队用氧、碳、锶同位素分析古湖沉积，说明大尺度水系变化会干扰只依赖有限同位素资料的古高度解释。
chapters.visual: A fixed mountain and moving river establish drainage context. An anonymous field scientist and gloved laboratory hand examine ancient lake-sediment specimens. No uplift, measured isotope values or documented field trip is reconstructed.
beats: Read multiple isotope records
读取多种同位素记录
A different drainage route changes the evidence
河流改道改变证据来源
Reconsider ancient-elevation estimates
重新判断古山高估算

papers.title: The effect of drainage reorganization on paleoaltimetry studies: An example from the Paleogene Laramide foreland
Stanford Terrestrial Paleoclimate publication record
Publisher abstract and issue date

chapters.continuity: Drainage changes can alter an elevation interpretation without physically changing the mountain’s height. The scene therefore leaves the mountain fixed in this year.
chapters.caveat_zh: 颜色代表同位素示意；不能把河流改道直接画成山体高度改变。

chapters.title: How do rivers and lake basins reorganize as mountains form?
chapters.question_zh: 山脉形成时，河网和湖盆怎样重组？
chapters.summary: New basin isotope records were integrated with a regional dataset to reconstruct evolving rivers, lakes and connected catchments.
chapters.summary_zh: 团队把新流域同位素记录放入区域数据集，重建河流贯通、湖盆阻断和流域整合的演变。
chapters.visual: Paired fixed-camera basin plates show separated catchments and an illustrative connecting gorge, with moving water confined to the connection. There are no sediment-vial collection scenes or animated mountain uplift. Terrain, timing and connections are representative rather than measured Laramide history.
beats: Start with separate basins
从不同湖盆出发
Mountain building reorganizes their drainage
造山过程重组水系
Reconnect the regional paleohydrology
重建区域古水文

papers.title: Synorogenic evolution of large-scale drainage patterns: Isotope paleohydrology of sequential Laramide basins

chapters.continuity: A direct continuation of isotope paleohydrology. The paired basin states illustrate drainage integration, not measured Laramide terrain, timing or mountain heights.

chapters.title: How does consumption connect to emissions, and how much future CO2 is committed by existing infrastructure?
chapters.question_zh: 消费如何关联排放？现有设施又承诺了多少未来排放？
chapters.branch: Carbon accounting and trade · Energy systems
chapters.summary: One study traced production emissions to final consumption; another estimated future emissions from installed energy infrastructure under operating-life and replacement assumptions.
chapters.summary_zh: 一项研究把生产排放追溯到最终消费；另一项在设备寿命与替换假设下估算现有能源设施的未来排放。
chapters.visual: A crane moves a container onto a vessel, followed by generic installed industrial equipment and an energy-services landscape. These illustrate parallel consumption-accounting and infrastructure-commitment questions.
beats: Trace production to consumption
从生产追溯到消费
A parallel question asks about installed devices
并行问题关注已安装的设备
Inspect both accounting and future commitment
共同检验核算与未来排放承诺

papers.title: Consumption-based accounting of CO2 emissions
Future CO2 emissions and climate change from existing energy infrastructure

chapters.continuity: Consumption accounting and infrastructure commitment appear in parallel. Use the question cards to inspect both.
chapters.caveat_zh: 贸易连线代表隐含排放归属，不是CO2随商品实物漂洋过海；排放承诺依赖寿命和使用假设。

cards.title: How does consumption connect to emissions across borders?
cards.question_zh: 消费如何关联跨境排放？
cards.summary: Consumption-based accounting and extraction-to-consumption supply chains follow carbon across borders..

papers.title: Consumption-based accounting of CO2 emissions

cards.visual: A loaded vessel arrives; the crane transfers a container onto its deck, and the vessel leaves with the goods. Consumption accounting links manufactured goods to production elsewhere; production emissions do not move inside the container.
beats: A factory emits; goods leave
工厂排放，商品出口
Follow the goods to their consumers
沿商品追踪到消费者
One carbon flow, different accounting boundaries
同一碳流，不同核算边界

cards.title: How much future CO₂ is committed by existing energy infrastructure?
cards.question_zh: 现有能源设施承诺了多少未来排放？
cards.summary: The study estimates future emissions from installed devices under assumptions about continued operation and replacement. It is a conditional estimate, not an inevitable forecast.

papers.title: Future CO2 emissions and climate change from existing energy infrastructure

cards.visual: Generic installed industrial equipment, a cement delivery and energy services illustrate conditional operating lives of existing infrastructure. Proposed infrastructure belongs to the separate 2019 question; no future emissions total is drawn.
beats: Existing devices continue operating
现有设施继续运行
Operating assumptions set the commitment
运行假设决定排放承诺
Compare lifetimes, use and replacement
比较寿命、利用率与替换

chapters.title: Where can policy act along the carbon chain from extraction to final consumption?
chapters.question_zh: 同一条碳链，从开采到消费，在哪里可以干预？
chapters.summary: The paper connected fuel extraction, combustion and final consumption to examine policy intervention at different points in the chain.
chapters.summary_zh: 论文把燃料来源、燃烧地点和最终消费连接起来，比较从供应链不同环节实施碳政策的意义。
chapters.visual: Four composed views follow bulk carbon-bearing fuel extraction/loading, industrial production, manufactured-goods cargo and final powered service. The same carbon is not added at every accounting boundary. Generic machinery, quantities and routes are not observed national flows.
beats: Begin at fuel extraction
从燃料开采出发
Follow combustion and final consumption
继续追踪燃烧与最终消费
Ask where policy can intervene
追问政策能在哪里干预

papers.title: The supply chain of CO2 emissions

chapters.continuity: Extraction, combustion and consumption are positions along one chain; summing their attributed emissions would double count.
chapters.caveat_zh: 开采、燃烧和消费是同一排放链的不同核算位置，不能把各环节数值相加成总排放。

chapters.title: How can international trade-carbon accounts be made consistent?
chapters.question_zh: 怎样统一核算国际贸易中的碳？
chapters.summary: The synthesis harmonized definitions, models and data, distinguishing embodied emissions from carbon physically contained in traded products.
chapters.summary_zh: 团队统一定义、模型和数据，区分商品生产引发的排放与燃料、作物等实际携带的碳，解释不同研究估计为何不同。
chapters.visual: Bulk-fuel loading leads to a records table: closed source folders open side by side and matching sheets are physically aligned before a manufactured-cargo view. The pages contain no reconstructed values. Fuel physically contains carbon; production emissions are attributed to ordinary manufactured goods through accounting.
beats: Different definitions produce different accounts
不同定义产生不同账本
Align the definitions and data
统一定义与数据
Keep physical carbon and embodied emissions distinct
区分实体碳与隐含排放

papers.title: A synthesis of carbon in international trade
Corrigendum to the 2012 synthesis

chapters.continuity: The synthesis has a published corrigendum. This film presents methods and questions without reproducing uncorrected numerical results.
chapters.caveat_zh: 综合研究有勘误；如后续添加数值或原图，须使用校正版本。动画只呈现方法与问题。

chapters.title: Do consuming regions outsource emissions to other provinces within the same country?
chapters.question_zh: 消费地区是否把排放转移到别的省份？
chapters.summary: A provincial input-output analysis traced production and consumption to reveal emissions transfers within China.
chapters.summary_zh: 论文用省际投入产出核算追踪消费与生产，揭示中国省份间贸易关联的排放转移。
chapters.visual: Industrial production and physical cargo transfers connect generic producing and consuming places. They do not identify observed Chinese provincial routes or reproduce a provincial emissions map.
beats: A national total is only one boundary
全国总量只是一个边界
Follow trade among consuming and producing regions
追踪消费与生产地区之间的贸易
Resolve provincial accounting perspectives
细分省级核算视角

papers.title: Outsourcing CO2 within China

chapters.continuity: The selected study concerns historical provincial trade and emissions. Its schematic does not substitute for current provincial data.
chapters.caveat_zh: 显示研究当年的贸易与排放关系；不能替代当前省份数据。

chapters.title: How do trade-linked production and trans-Pacific pollution transport affect air quality?
chapters.question_zh: 贸易生产与跨洋污染输送怎样共同影响空气质量？
chapters.branch: Carbon accounting and trade · Health impacts
chapters.summary: Trade-linked emissions were coupled to atmospheric chemistry modeling to assess effects on US air quality.
chapters.summary_zh: 团队将出口关联排放与大气化学模型结合，评估中国国际贸易相关污染对美国空气质量的影响。
chapters.visual: A cargo transfer and a separate painted atmospheric band lead to a representative neighborhood. Visible aerosol/cloud imagery is not CO₂ or a calculated trans-Pacific concentration field.
beats: Trade and wind are different cross-border links
贸易与风是不同的跨境联系
Couple economic accounts with atmospheric chemistry
把经济核算连接到大气化学
Assess air quality where people live
评估人们居住地区的空气质量

papers.title: China's international trade and air pollution in the United States

chapters.continuity: Economic attribution and physical air-pollution transport are different mechanisms. CO₂ is not physically transported inside the cargo boxes.
chapters.caveat_zh: 经济归属与物理污染输送必须使用不同图例；不要画成所有隐含CO2都会随风回到进口国。

chapters.title: Which regions and industries offer targeted opportunities to cut export-related emissions?
chapters.question_zh: 出口减排应瞄准哪些地区和行业？
chapters.summary: The study linked export-related emissions to the coal-based energy mix and especially emissions-intensive provinces and sectors, identifying targeted mitigation opportunities.
chapters.summary_zh: 研究发现中国出口隐含排放与煤炭能源结构及少数高排放强度地区、行业密切相关，因此干预可以有针对性。
chapters.visual: Generic production and energy-system shots compare intervention contexts. No illustrated machine is assigned a measured regional abatement outcome.
beats: Regions and sectors are not uniform
地区与行业并不相同
Focus on a specific intervention point
聚焦具体干预点
Compare energy and technology opportunities
比较能源结构与技术机会

papers.title: Targeted opportunities to address the climate–trade dilemma in China
papers.note: Online 2015; Nature Climate Change volume6/pages201–206 is dated2016.

chapters.continuity: Online publication was 2015; the final Nature Climate Change volume is 2016. Selection follows the online date.
chapters.caveat_zh: 按在线发表年份放在2015；流线变化是机制示意，不是动画重新计算的研究数值。

chapters.tag_zh: 材料也有完整生命周期
chapters.title: How much CO2 does cement absorb during use and after disposal?
chapters.question_zh: 水泥在使用和废弃过程中又吸收了多少CO2？
chapters.summary: The team estimated CO2 uptake through cement carbonation across lifecycle stages, adding an often-overlooked sink to material carbon accounts.
chapters.summary_zh: 团队估算水泥在不同生命周期阶段通过碳化吸收的CO2，将常被漏计的碳汇纳入材料碳账。
chapters.visual: A grounded cement delivery and smaller concrete worker progress through placement, smoothing, later-life sampling and a visible concrete tray. There is no sediment laboratory scene, visible CO₂ sink, measured carbonation rate or cancellation of production emissions.
beats: Material production is one stage
材料生产只是一个阶段
Follow use, aging and later lifecycle stages
继续追踪使用、老化与后续阶段
Add the overlooked carbonation flow
补上被遗漏的碳化过程

papers.title: Substantial global carbon uptake by cement carbonation

chapters.continuity: Carbonation is not presented as canceling all production emissions or making cement carbon neutral.
chapters.caveat_zh: 碳化吸收不能画成抵消全部生产排放，也不表示水泥已经碳中和。

chapters.title: Who bears the health impacts of international trade and transported air pollution?
chapters.question_zh: 跨境贸易与污染输送的健康代价由谁承担？
chapters.branch: Health impacts · Carbon accounting and trade
chapters.summary: Linked economic, emissions, air-pollution and health models distinguished trade-related health impacts from those caused by cross-border atmospheric transport.
chapters.summary_zh: 团队组合经济、排放、空气污染和健康模型，区分贸易消费关联的健康影响与污染跨境输送的健康影响。
chapters.visual: A moving cargo chain and a distinct atmospheric/community view separate trade from pollution transport. No individual health case, exposure value or geographic burden estimate is pictured.
beats: Combine economic, emissions and atmospheric models
结合经济、排放与大气模型
Distinguish trade from pollution transport
区分贸易联系与污染输送
Connect the estimates to human health
把估算连接到健康影响

papers.title: Transboundary health impacts of transported global air pollution and international trade

chapters.continuity: Population icons illustrate a modeled health-impact boundary, not invented individual cases.
chapters.caveat_zh: 以人群图标表达估算的健康风险，避免虚构个体病例。

chapters.title: How can net-zero energy deliver reliable power and hard-to-abate services?
chapters.question_zh: 净零能源怎样保持可靠，并覆盖难减排行业？
chapters.summary: A system review examined the difficult components of net-zero energy, while an hourly-weather analysis tested reliability constraints for wind, solar, storage and capacity.
chapters.summary_zh: 一项综述梳理净零能源系统的难点；另一项用长期逐小时天气记录检验风光、储能和容量配置的可靠性约束。
chapters.visual: Wind rotors and a material-handling vehicle operate amid a moving weather cloud, with a separate hard-to-abate industrial view. This is not calculated dispatch or proof that one battery guarantees reliability.
beats: Annual energy is not hourly reliability
年度能量不等于逐小时可靠性
Weather, storage and other services interact
天气、储能与其他服务相互关联
Test the complete net-zero system
检验完整的净零系统

papers.title: Net-zero emissions energy systems
Geophysical constraints on the reliability of solar and wind power

chapters.continuity: This simplified sequence does not establish one universal power-system design or demonstrate that a single battery ensures reliability.
chapters.caveat_zh: 年度发电量足够不等于每小时可靠；不要把风光研究的简化系统结论画成所有现实电网的唯一方案。

chapters.tag_zh: 看见基础设施的时间惯性
chapters.title: How much future CO2 is committed by existing and proposed infrastructure?
chapters.question_zh: 现有和计划中的设施会承诺多少未来排放？
chapters.branch: Energy systems · Carbon accounting and trade
chapters.summary: Infrastructure inventories, lifetimes and utilization assumptions were used to compare committed emissions with the 1.5°C carbon budget available at the time.
chapters.summary_zh: 研究结合设施清单、寿命和利用率假设，将现有与拟建基础设施的未来排放和当时的1.5°C碳预算进行比较。
chapters.visual: An operating industrial delivery is followed by the same empty site as a conditional stopped-operation alternative, then a separate replacement power context. This is not instantaneous conversion of an entire plant or inevitable future operation.
beats: Existing and planned devices extend into the future
现有与计划设施延伸到未来
Operating assumptions set the commitment
运行假设决定排放承诺
Compare lifetimes, use and replacement
比较寿命、利用率与替换

papers.title: Committed emissions from existing energy infrastructure jeopardize 1.5°C climate target

chapters.continuity: Committed emissions depend on lifetime, utilization and replacement assumptions. The paper’s historical carbon budget is not a current 2026 remaining budget.
chapters.caveat_zh: 承诺排放是条件估计；历史碳预算不能标为2026当前剩余预算。

chapters.title: Can we estimate global CO2 emissions day by day?
chapters.question_zh: 能否逐日看见全球排放怎样变化？
chapters.summary: Carbon Monitor converted activity data from power, industry, transport and other sectors into daily emissions estimates.
chapters.summary_zh: Carbon Monitor把电力、工业、交通、航空等活动数据转成每日排放估计，展示年度总量遮住的变化。
chapters.visual: A power-activity context leads to physical source-record checking: separate folders become aligned sheets and an organized activity binder with an unlabeled calendar, then an industrial-activity context. This is an illustration of activity-to-daily-estimate work, not measured time-series data, direct CO₂ sensing or an event attribution.
beats: Start with an annual aggregate
从年度总量出发
Turn activity data into daily estimates
把活动数据转为每日估算
Reveal timing that an annual total conceals
揭示年度总量遮住的时序

papers.title: Carbon Monitor, a near-real-time daily dataset of global CO2 emission from fossil fuel and cement production

chapters.continuity: Daily values are activity-based estimates, not a direct worldwide CO₂ sensor network. The physical folders and calendar illustrate record handling without reproducing numerical time-series values.
chapters.caveat_zh: 这是基于活动数据的排放估计，不能画成覆盖全球的直接CO2传感器测量。

chapters.title: Which combinations of technologies can deeply reduce cement-production emissions?
chapters.question_zh: 哪些技术组合可以深度降低水泥生产排放？
chapters.summary: The analysis examined combinations of fuel and clinker substitution, efficiency and carbon capture, distinguishing process emissions from energy-related emissions.
chapters.summary_zh: 该分析讨论燃料和熟料替代、效率与碳捕集的组合，区分工艺化学与能源使用产生的排放。
chapters.visual: Generic industrial production, a separate energy-service context and a return to production distinguish intervention scopes. No sediment-vial laboratory protocol, observed technology combination or measured capture performance is pictured.
beats: Separate process chemistry from energy use
区分工艺化学与能源使用
Combine different technological levers
组合不同的技术手段
Test which sources each option addresses
检验每种技术针对哪些排放源

papers.title: Decarbonizing cement production
papers.note: Publication date confirmed by the authors' university.

papers.title: Best ways to cut carbon emissions from the cement industry explored

chapters.continuity: The analysis compares production interventions. Its direct-production scope is distinct from a complete lifecycle account and a measured factory trial.
chapters.caveat_zh: 不是新建工厂的实测成果；直接生产排放分析不能替代完整生命周期核算。

chapters.tag_zh: 跟随食物与土地的足迹
chapters.title: Where does international trade transfer land-use emissions?
chapters.question_zh: 商品贸易把土地利用排放转移到哪里？
chapters.branch: Carbon accounting and trade · Food and land
chapters.summary: New emissions estimates and a multiregional input-output model traced trade-related agriculture and land-use-change emissions over 2004–2017.
chapters.summary_zh: 团队用新的排放估计和多区域投入产出模型，追踪2004–2017年农业与土地利用变化排放的生产消费关系。
chapters.visual: A crop truck follows the farm path toward processing; a port handoff follows consumption, then returns to the production landscape. The forest remains intact, and no shipment is assigned a deforestation history.
beats: Resolve agricultural and land-use-change emissions
细分农业与土地利用变化排放
Follow goods to their consumers
沿商品追踪到消费者
Extend the trade-accounting boundary
拓展贸易核算边界

papers.title: Land-use emissions embodied in international trade

chapters.continuity: Agriculture and land-use change are separate emissions sources. Trade does not imply that all production required new deforestation.
chapters.caveat_zh: 核算既包括农业排放，也包括土地利用变化；避免画成全部贸易都导致新砍伐。

chapters.tag_zh: 从电力目标到材料清单
chapters.title: How much material does clean power require, and how far must production expand?
chapters.question_zh: 净零电力需要多少材料，意味着多大的生产扩张？
chapters.summary: The study combined 75 climate-energy scenarios with generation-technology material intensities, distinguishing cumulative geological availability from annual production-growth requirements.
chapters.summary_zh: 研究将75个气候能源情景与发电技术材料强度连接，区分累计地质资源需求与逐年生产扩张要求。
chapters.visual: A forklift carries and deposits a material pallet; a separate geological outcrop and excavator loading cycle distinguish a qualitative stock from physical throughput; the equipment context returns. Strata color does not identify an element or assay, and no reserve tonnage, annual production quantity or shortage is encoded.
beats: Translate energy deployment into materials
把能源部署换算为材料需求
A geological stock differs from annual production
地下储量不同于年产量
Ask how much production must expand
追问生产需要扩张多少

papers.title: Future demand for electricity generation materials under different climate mitigation scenarios
Public data and code archive
papers.note: Associated with the 2023 paper; archive release date is distinct from paper publication. Exact archive date omitted.

chapters.continuity: The scope is electricity-generation infrastructure, not every NdFeB application. Demand estimates do not themselves prove a shortage or validate deliveries.
chapters.caveat_zh: 论文范围是发电基础设施；它估算需求与扩产规模，不证明所有材料短缺必然发生，也不覆盖全部磁体用途。

chapters.title: What can net-zero scenarios tell decision makers, and which regional differences do national totals hide?
chapters.question_zh: 净零情景能指导什么，国家总量又掩盖哪些差异？
chapters.summary: The study compared US net-zero scenarios and US results from global models, showing substantial differences in technologies and regional pathways under the same target.
chapters.summary_zh: 研究比较美国净零情景和全球模型中的美国结果，说明同一目标下技术路径与地区变化很不相同。
chapters.visual: Different energy and agricultural/land settings compare the constraints within a shared target. Neither alternative has an assigned probability or is shown as an observed future.
beats: Start with a shared net-zero target
从共同的净零目标出发
Compare different technology pathways
比较不同的技术路径
Resolve regions and the limits of scenarios
细分地区差异与情景方法的局限

papers.title: Uses and limits of national decarbonization scenarios to inform net-zero transitions
Author-institution publication and abstract record

chapters.continuity: Scenario ensembles are comparisons, not probability distributions or a single inevitable forecast. Earlier accounting and materials branches continue.
chapters.caveat_zh: 情景集合不是概率分布或唯一预测；这一年并不表示所有旧研究分支结束。

chapters.title: How does the net-zero transition reshape energy-related trade risks?
chapters.question_zh: 净零转型会怎样重塑能源贸易风险？
chapters.branch: Materials · Energy systems · Carbon accounting and trade
chapters.summary: Net-zero scenarios were linked to materials and trade-risk indicators, revealing differing changes as fossil-fuel dependence declines and critical-material imports grow.
chapters.summary_zh: 论文把净零情景、材料和贸易风险指标连接，显示减少化石燃料依赖和增加关键材料进口可能带来不同方向的风险变化。
chapters.visual: Cargo and energy-equipment actions illustrate changing import and material dependence. There is no simulated blockade, observed outage or inferred customer-qualified magnet shortage.
beats: Decarbonization changes import dependence
减碳改变进口依赖
Compare networks, materials and assumptions
比较网络、材料与假设
Trade exposure is distinct from delivered supply
贸易暴露不同于可用交付

papers.title: Trade risks to energy security in net-zero emissions energy scenarios
The importance of multiregional accounting for corporate carbon emissions
papers.note: Online 2025-12-20; final Nature Communications volume17/article1014 is2026.

chapters.continuity: The national trade-risk index follows resource geography and broad material proxies; it is not a customer-qualified magnet shortage probability. Corporate accounting continues the earlier boundary question.
chapters.caveat_zh: 贸易风险指标不是磁体断供概率或可用交付量；研究按储量所在国处理材料来源，不解析所有冶炼和制造位置。
